name: sgs/google-reviews
title: SGS Google Reviews
description: Display Google Business Profile reviews with aggregate ratings and schema.org markup.

sgs._comment_scalarContentLift: Added 2026-09-21. The reviews[] repeater already lifts through arrayContentLift; this opts the block's own header figures into the converter's scalar lift so a draft that names them lifts them: averageRating (numeric-content) and reviewCount (numeric-content), each read from the element carrying the class <block root class>__<kebab attribute name> (attr-classification-overrides.json holds the role and derived_selector, as for sgs/testimonial.ratingScale). reviewRequestUrl (link-href) is reached by the same class-to-attribute-name route. businessName (text-content, derived_selector .sgs-google-reviews__business-name) is the CLIENT's business, so it is lifted only from a header caption that is NOT this block's own name: the annotation stage reports a caption equal to the block's own name as SKIPPED with that reason (measured on the Eye Care run: the draft's 'Google Reviews' caption is the review SOURCE label, not a business name, and the block draws its own source logo), and no businessName reaches the emit for such a draft. A real business-name caption still lifts. Metadata only: no attribute, default or render behaviour changes.
sgs._comment_mediaElements: Rule 37-media-no-handroll fix. The reviewer avatar photo (pulled live from the Google Places API, rendered by this block's own render.php loop) now routes its object-fit through the shared media-element atom layer instead of a style.css literal. This is a NEW client control -- no pre-existing object-fit picker on this block. render.php emits the atom's --sgs-media-object-fit custom property scoped to the block wrapper ($gr_uid) and appends the shared .sgs-media-el marker class to each avatar ; style.css no longer hardcodes object-fit on .sgs-google-reviews__avatar img, relying on assets/css/media-atoms/object-fit.css's cover fallback (identical default).

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Root, rendered by SGS_Container_Wrapper (container_kind=layout, wraps sgs/container — WS-4). Empty-string prefix lets the default {suffix} convention resolve the bare universal-container attrs case-insensitively: maxWidth, gap(+Tablet/Mobile), gridTemplateColumns/Rows(+Tablet/Mobile), gridAutoRows, flexDirection, flexWrap, alignItems, alignContent, justifyContent, justifyItems all resolve this way — no attrMap needed for those. Honest gaps: no display/order/overflow/width/height/max-height/min-height/box-shadow/aspect-ratio attribute exists on this block; no padding/margin attribute or native support is declared (spacing support absent); opacity/overlay/background-attachment/-position/-repeat/object-fit/object-position have no control (this block has no image element); anim:stagger/parallax/trigger have no matching attrs (no staggerDelay/parallax/scroll-trigger control here) — honest gaps, not orphans. starColour/cardStyle/theme/variant are variant/preset selectors, not style-cluster members — deliberately undeclared (no prefix claims them, so they surface neither as gap nor orphan).

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Mirrors sgs/container's `inner` element (block.json). Added 2026-08-05 (Bean): gaps are GRID-element properties — they sit between a block's internal pieces, inside both the OUTER layer and the content-width layer, so they belong to neither. Before this, gap/gapTablet/gapMobile on this block resolved to NO css_property at all: the shared SGS_Container_Wrapper renders them (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:166-169) but the emission scanner only reads each block's OWN render.php/style.css, and this block declared no explicit attrMap to fall back on. The prefix convention could not have covered it either — with an empty prefix the candidate is built as prefix + PascalCase suffix ("" + "Gap" = "Gap"), which never matches the real lowercase attribute name. That is the same limitation sgs/container's own inner `_note` documents. Explicit mapping is the established fix, not a workaround.

star.label: Star icon
star._note: The rating-stars SVG (sgs_render_stars_svg(), render.php:341-390) — full/half-fill stars carry an enum-modifier class on the wrapper (sgs-google-reviews--star-{slug}, render.php:222) that style.css keys off (.sgs-google-reviews--star-{slug} .sgs-google-reviews__star--full{fill:...}, style.css:168-176). starColour's PRIMARY, visible effect is this SVG fill — earlier classification derived background-color instead, because the same attribute ALSO feeds --sgs-gr-star-colour (render.php:230-232), a custom property with a SECOND, low-visibility consumer: .sgs-google-reviews__breakdown-fill (style.css:120, the ratings-breakdown bars, hidden unless showBreakdown is on) and .sgs-google-reviews__dot.is-active::before (style.css:579, the slider pagination dot). Same one-attribute-drives-two-unrelated-CSS-properties-on-two-unrelated-elements shape as product-search's `input` element note for inputBorderColour — declared on the primary, named node (the star SVG); the background-color consumer rides the same underlying value rather than getting a second manifest entry. Palette-coverage gap (style.css only recognises 2 legacy enum values against the full open-palette control) is a separate, unfixed client-facing bug — not addressed by this classification fix.

star-empty.label: Empty star
star-empty._note: The unfilled part of a star (.sgs-google-reviews__star--empty). Its own element because a cluster member claims exactly one attribute and css:fill on the star element is starColour.

arrow.label: Slider arrow
arrow._note: The prev/next slider-arrow button (.sgs-google-reviews__arrow). Added 2026-09-03 alongside the hover-colour + gradient migration off a hardcoded style.css :hover rule -- render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'arrow', which reads exactly this attrMap shape by $prefix.'Suffix' concatenation. arrowColourTextGradient/arrowColourTextHoverGradient added 2026-09-04 (helpers-button-style.php D942/D956 gate) -- keyed css:color-gradient, distinct from the fill's css:background-image, since render.php now passes bg_layer=true (with bg_layer_positioned=true, as .sgs-google-reviews__arrow already carries its own position:absolute in style.css) so this element's background paints on a separate ::after layer instead of this selector, freeing the text for a gradient sibling.

write-review.label: Write-review button
write-review._note: The 'Write a review' CTA button (.sgs-google-reviews__write-review). Added 2026-09-03 alongside the hover-colour + gradient migration off a hardcoded style.css :hover rule -- render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'writeReview', which reads exactly this attrMap shape by $prefix.'Suffix' concatenation. writeReviewColourTextGradient/writeReviewColourTextHoverGradient added 2026-09-04 (helpers-button-style.php D942/D956 gate) -- keyed css:color-gradient, distinct from the fill's css:background-image, since render.php now passes bg_layer=true so this element's background paints on a separate ::after layer instead of this selector, freeing the text for a gradient sibling (same recipe as sgs/modal's closeColourTextGradient).

header.label: Header row
header._note: headerDividerColour / headerDividerWidth are the header row's bottom divider (the row draws one edge only, border-bottom); they register on the border-colour / border-width members because the vocabulary has no per-edge bottom member.

average.label: Rating figure
average._note: css_element is 'average', not 'score': the slots table lists 'score' as an alias of the 'rating' slot, so the draft's star run (annotated __rating) would resolve to this element through the alias group instead of to the star element. The attribute prefix stays 'score'.

text.label: Review text
text._note: textClamp / textClampLines cut the review text to N lines (-webkit-line-clamp); the vocabulary has no line-clamp member, so they are classified 'behaviour' in the DB override rather than claimed here.

list.label: Review rail
list._note: scrollbar / scrollbarColour are the rail's scrollbar settings; they do not start with this element's prefix and the vocabulary has no scrollbar member, so they are named in the DB override (css_property scrollbar-width / scrollbar-color, css_element list) rather than here.

see-all.label: See-all-reviews button
see-all._note: The 'See all reviews' pill. Same recipe as the write-review and arrow elements: render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'seeAll'.

fx._comment_providesNatively: Spec 38 FR-38-13 / §7. This block owns drag-to-scroll through its OWN inspector toggle, which targets the DESCENDANT element that actually scrolls. The generic 'Scroll & effects' picker stamps data-sgs-fx onto the block ROOT, which is not the scroller here — so offering `draggable` there too would give the client TWO controls for ONE capability, and the picker's one would silently do nothing. Declaring it here removes the dud picker entry via generate-fx-qualifying-blocks.py without removing the capability, exactly as sgs/responsive-logo does for `draw`. Ruled 2026-07-31 after the roster derivation surfaced it on five blocks at once (gallery had it latently already). NOTE sgs/timeline deliberately does NOT carry this: its scroller IS the block root, so the picker lands correctly there.

dataSource.description: auto (default): the written reviews when there are any, otherwise Google. synced: always Google (needs a place ID and API key, returns at most 5 reviews). inline: always the written reviews. placeholder: three clearly sample reviews for building a layout; the ONLY mode that ever shows sample reviews, and it emits no review schema. With no written reviews and no live Google data, auto/synced/inline render nothing on the front end.

rating.description: Optional. A written review with no rating renders without stars and is never dropped by the minimum-rating filter.

date.description: Free text shown as written ('2 years ago', 'March 2026'). Shown in preference to a computed relative time.

datePublished.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the review. Used for the machine-readable datetime and for sorting; the visible text comes from 'date' when set.

meta.description: Reviewer detail line, for example 'Local Guide · 11 reviews'.

avatarColour.description: Initials-avatar background when there is no photo. A palette slug or a CSS colour.

_key._note: Client-generated stable identity (src/utils/generateItemKey.js), not a client-visible field. Keeps an item's editor state through reorder, add and remove.

cardStyle.description: Card look: a ready-made starting style for the review cards. flat / bordered / elevated are the plain looks; google-card copies the Google Reviews panel; quote-minimal is borderless and quiet; boxed is a solid tile; bubble is a soft speech-bubble card; wall-tile is a thin-lined tile for a dense wall. Any value set in the card, avatar or star controls paints over the look.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

writeReviewColourBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the write-review button's fill instead of a flat colour (delegates to sgs_background_paint_decl()). Non-empty wins over writeReviewColourBackground.

writeReviewColourTextGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the 'Write a review' button's text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D942/D956 mechanism, sgs_button_element_style_css() bg_layer=true moves the background paint onto a ::after layer to free this selector for the gradient). Non-empty wins over writeReviewColourText.

arrowColourBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the slider arrow's fill instead of a flat colour (delegates to sgs_background_paint_decl()). Non-empty wins over arrowColourBackground.

arrowColourTextGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the slider arrow's text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D942/D956 mechanism, sgs_button_element_style_css() bg_layer=true moves the background paint onto a ::after layer to free this selector for the gradient). Non-empty wins over arrowColourText.

arrowColourBorderGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the slider arrow's border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 mechanism, already supported by sgs_button_element_style_css()). Non-empty wins over arrowColourBorder.

dotColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the slider pagination dot's fill instead of a flat colour (delegates to sgs_background_paint_decl()). Non-empty wins over dotColour.

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the card background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColour.

sourceLabel.description: The review source caption shown beside the logo (for example 'Google Reviews'). Not the client's business name.

cardBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the review card border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over cardBorderColour.

textClamp.description: On: the review text is cut to textClampLines lines. Off: the full review shows.

showCardLogo.description: Show a small Google 'G' at the top right of each review card.

showReviewLink.description: Show a 'Read the full review' link under a review that carries its own URL.

footnote.description: A short line under the review rail, for example how many reviews left a comment.

writeReviewLabel.description: Text of the 'Write a review' button. Empty keeps the built-in wording.

seeAllUrl.description: Link for the 'See all reviews' button. Empty hides the button.

seeAllLabel.description: Text of the 'See all reviews' button. Empty keeps the built-in wording.

seeAllColourBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string for the see-all button's background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

seeAllColourBackgroundHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string for the see-all button's background (hover) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

seeAllColourTextGradient.description: CSS gradient string for the see-all button's text instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

seeAllColourTextHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string for the see-all button's text (hover) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

seeAllColourBorderGradient.description: CSS gradient string for the see-all button's border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

seeAllColourBorderHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string for the see-all button's border (hover) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over the flat colour.
